formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : Fin x1) (x3 : Bool → Bool) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x4 → x4.output ≠ x1 → ∃ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x7 ∧ x7.size ≤ x4.size ∧ ∀ (x8 : Fin x1 → Bool), x7.eval (List.ofFn x8 ++ [!x8 x2]) = x4.eval (List.ofFn x8 ++ [x3 (x8 x2)])
plain_statement: For a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates on n inputs and one extra wire, whose output is not the extra wire, and any function g of one bit: some circuit of the same kind, no larger, with the extra wire carrying NOT x_v, computes what the first computes when its extra wire carries g(x_v).
title: A step toward: A step toward: Petersen graph: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 19 gates computes its edge function
